theme: Getting less risky at exactly the wrong speed
title: State-Dependent Glidepath: De-Risking on Funded Ratio and Horizon Together
strategies: trivial: fully-immunized policy (0% risky every year, every bucket) -- the checker's own baseline
greedy: linear age-based glidepath, ignoring funded ratio entirely (industry default)
